name: Schema changes are constrained after registration
symptom: ingest-tickets.ps1 -AddRefinableLater: the schema PATCH is rejected or the schema operation ends in failed when adding refinable property costCentre
cause: Refinable cannot be added in a schema update; a property cannot be both searchable and refinable
fix: Add costCentre without isRefinable, or delete the connection and register a new schema; decide refiners at first registration

name: ACL deny beats grant
symptom: Learner and Marcus (Ops-Ontario) get no result for ticket 104321; Priya and Sofia see SI-2026-014
cause: Ticket 104321 grants everyoneExceptGuests but denies <Prefix>-Ops-Ontario; deny overrides grant
fix: Expected behavior. Document deny rules; change the source ACL and re-ingest only if the intent changes; never widen to everyone

name: Indexing latency after ingestion
symptom: Observe and record: right after Ingestion finished, agents and the Search API may not find items the ACL allows (for example ticket 102600)
cause: Ingestion and indexing are separate steps; agents query the index. No documented duration
fix: Wait and re-test; check the item count in the admin center before testing; record measured latency

name: Missing title and url semantic labels
symptom: Observe and record: after removing the title and url labels, citations lose their title or link, or the ticket stops being used
cause: Semantic labels map title, url and iconUrl; title drives result clusters and default result types; only retrievable properties can be labelled
fix: Restore labels with Set-TicketLabels.ps1 -Cleanup; map all labels at first registration

name: Items not appearing for guests
symptom: Guest does not see ticket 103115 (everyoneExceptGuests); result for ticket 102600 (everyone) is observed, not asserted; agents may be unavailable without a license
cause: everyoneExceptGuests excludes guests; guest behavior for everyone is undocumented; licensing gates agents separately
fix: Use everyoneExceptGuests or group grants for guest exclusion; test guest access in your tenant and record it

name: Admin roles for connectors
symptom: Non-admin persona cannot open the connector admin pages; connector missing from the Agent Builder knowledge picker until an admin enables it
cause: Connector administration needs AI Administrator, with Search Administrator for Data sources; app-only ingest permissions give users no admin rights
fix: Assign AI Administrator or Search Administrator with least privilege; have the admin enable the connector
